title: Personal Checking: which maintenance charge a same-day waiver review concerns, and the amount returned
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Personal Checking account questions the monthly maintenance charge on the cycle closing date, the current business day. It identifies the charge under review and fixes the amount returned when the review finds it was assessed although a waiver was met.

## Formal clauses

1. **The charge in question.** The charge in question is the monthly maintenance charge posted on the account on the current business day.
2. **Amount returned.** When this review refunds that charge, it is refunded in full, never in part, at its own amount, recorded as a bank-error refund.

## Identification table

| Monthly maintenance charge on the account | Under this review? |
|---|---|
| Posted on the current business day | Yes |
| Posted on an earlier cycle closing date | No |

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

- **Which charge.** An account shows a monthly maintenance charge posted today and another posted at the previous cycle close. Only the one posted today is the charge in question.
- **Amount.** Today's monthly maintenance charge posted at 13.50 USD. When this review refunds it, the refund is 13.50 USD, the charge's own amount; it is never a part of it.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "a charge refunded as a bank error may be returned in part". **Correct basis:** it is refunded in full, never in part, at its own amount.
- **Wrong reading:** "last month's maintenance charge can be reviewed the same way today". **Correct basis:** this review concerns the monthly maintenance charge posted on the current business day.
